name: duology-ship
description: Test and ship for iPhone Duo: duo-migrate (moving an app that ships today to Xcode 27.1 and the scene life cycle), duo-app-store (Duo App Store screenshots, review notes and the April 2027 rules), duo-lint (the fold linter), an opt-in lint hook, tests on the Duo simulator, screenshots closed, open, in book pose and in tabletop (duo-pose-matrix), /duo-audit, /duo-poses, /duo-ship (the App Store checklist) and the duo-pose-tester agent (reads pose runs, reports each failure).
